decisions.reason: The address autocomplete web service draws on the firm's existing databases and infrastructure, so it costs little to keep, and it supports the platform strategy as a modular component.

The Austrian gas grid fee database is a growth option into a neighbouring market whose value is still uncertain, and maintaining it has a moderate data upkeep cost, so the firm keeps the option open for now.
Peak load window determination is a regulated, recurring need for network operators that fits the core business and is cheap to maintain.
The end-customer tariff database is closely tied to the firm's core market data business and likely brings steady demand from suppliers and comparison users.
Custom web services are a flexible, demand-driven offer that costs almost nothing to keep and fits the platform direction.
The postal code lookup service reuses the firm's established geodata, so its holding cost is minimal and it complements the other web services.
